title: GenerateAnswerResponse
description: Response from the model for a grounded answer.

answerableProbability.description: Output only. The model's estimate of the probability that its answer is correct and grounded in the input passages. A low `answerable_probability` indicates that the answer might not be grounded in the sources. When `answerable_probability` is low, you may want to: * Display a message to the effect of "We couldn’t answer that question" to the user. * Fall back to a general-purpose LLM that answers the question from world knowledge. The threshold and nature of such fallbacks will depend on individual use cases. `0.5` is a good starting threshold.
